title: Rethinking Latent Reasoning for Generative Recommendation: Beyond Teacher-Generated CoT and Recurrent Hidden-State Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.09006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent reasoning in generative recommendation faces two practical barriers: constructing teacher-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision is costly, and recurrent hidden-state feedback requires a specialized execution loop. We revisit both the supervision source and the computation interface. A step-level diagnosis measures how recommendation CoT supports next-item prediction and trace coherence. In the analyzed traces, history analysis is the only step with positive mean contributions on both dimensions, while later preference and intent steps have negative mean answer contributions. Guided by this finding, we propose PHiT (Prefilled, History-Informed Thought Tokens), which learns intermediate states from semantic targets extracted directly from observed item histories. PHiT aggregates cached sparse item encodings to construct these targets and supervises the contextual states of distinct vocabulary thought tokens. All thought token

translated_title: 重新思考生成式推荐中的潜在推理：超越教师生成的思维链与循环隐状态反馈
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐中的潜在推理面临两个实际障碍：构建教师生成的思维链监督成本高昂，而循环隐状态反馈需要专门的执行循环。我们重新审视了监督来源和计算接口。一项步骤级诊断衡量了推荐思维链如何支持下一物品预测和轨迹连贯性。在所分析的轨迹中，历史分析是唯一在两个维度上都具有正平均贡献的步骤，而后面的偏好和意图步骤则具有负的平均答案贡献。受此发现启发，我们提出了PHiT（预填充的历史信息驱动思维令牌，Prefilled, History-Informed Thought Tokens），它从直接观察到的物品历史中提取语义目标，并据此学习中间状态。PHiT聚合缓存的稀疏物品编码来构建这些目标，并监督不同词汇思维令牌的上下文状态。（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PHiT方法，直接从物品历史中提取语义目标来学习思维令牌的中间状态，从而摆脱了对昂贵的教师生成思维链监督和专门的循环隐状态执行循环的依赖。
en_tdlr: PHiT learns intermediate reasoning states directly from semantic targets extracted from observed item histories, eliminating the need for costly teacher-generated CoT supervision and specialized recurrent hidden-state execution loops in generative recommendation.
